title: Video Analysis Result
description: Schema for standardizing video analysis payloads from Perceptron Mk1, Isaac, and Barnstorm Intelligence models.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the analysis was generated.

model.description: The identifier of the vision-language model used (e.g., 'perceptron-mk1', 'isaac-edge-v2').

video_reference.description: URI or file path of the source video.

overall_summary.description: A high-level text summary of the video contents.

edl_export_ready.description: Flag indicating if the events array is formatted properly to be directly compiled into an Edit Decision List (EDL).

events.description: List of temporally bounded events, actions, or physical dynamics identified in the video.

description.description: Detailed text description of the event or action.

confidence.description: Model confidence score for the event.

physical_properties.description: Optional structured data about object dynamics, spatial positioning, or physical reasoning applied.
